# Reminders (1.13): what iOS 26 does with the lists of its Reminders app
# on a CalDAV account, written by hand after RFC 4791 and what iOS is
# reported to send (to be confirmed on a real iPhone). The home set shows
# the calendars and, after them, the virtual list "Erinnerungen" (VTODO)
# until the account has a list of its own.
> PROPFIND /caldav/alex/calendars/
> Auth: alex
> Depth: 1
>
> <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
> <A:propfind xmlns:A="DAV:" xmlns:B="urn:ietf:params:xml:ns:caldav" xmlns:C="http://calendarserver.org/ns/" xmlns:D="http://apple.com/ns/ical/"><A:prop><C:getctag/><A:sync-token/><A:resourcetype/><A:displayname/><D:calendar-color/><D:calendar-order/><B:supported-calendar-component-set/><A:current-user-privilege-set/><A:supported-report-set/><B:calendar-description/></A:prop></A:propfind>
< status 207
< responses 3
< value /caldav/alex/calendars/privat/ cal:supported-calendar-component-set <cal:comp name="VEVENT"/>
< value /caldav/alex/calendars/erinnerungen--titanos/ cal:supported-calendar-component-set <cal:comp name="VTODO"/>
< value /caldav/alex/calendars/erinnerungen--titanos/ d:resourcetype <d:collection/><cal:calendar/>
< value /caldav/alex/calendars/erinnerungen--titanos/ d:displayname Erinnerungen
< value /caldav/alex/calendars/erinnerungen--titanos/ ical:calendar-color #c2410c
< value /caldav/alex/calendars/erinnerungen--titanos/ cs:getctag 0-0
< value /caldav/alex/calendars/erinnerungen--titanos/ d:sync-token https://ns.titanos.invalid/sync/0/0
< privileges /caldav/alex/calendars/erinnerungen--titanos/ read write write-properties write-content bind unbind read-current-user-privilege-set
< value /caldav/alex/calendars/erinnerungen--titanos/ d:supported-report-set <d:supported-report><d:report><cal:calendar-query/></d:report></d:supported-report>
< save home prop /caldav/alex/calendars/ cs:getctag

# The first sync of the list: nothing yet.
> REPORT /caldav/alex/calendars/erinnerungen--titanos/
> Auth: alex
>
> <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
> <A:sync-collection xmlns:A="DAV:"><A:sync-token/><A:sync-level>1</A:sync-level><A:prop><A:getetag/><A:getcontenttype/></A:prop></A:sync-collection>
< status 207
< responses 0
< save virtual sync-token

# A new reminder with date, time and an alarm (iOS writes DTSTART and
# DUE, the alarm at an absolute time, its own X-APPLE properties).
> PUT /caldav/alex/calendars/erinnerungen--titanos/9B1F0D3E-2A4C-4B6D-8E0F-1A2B3C4D5E6F.ics
> Auth: alex
> Content-Type: text/calendar; charset=utf-8
> If-None-Match: *
> Body: reminder-new.ics
< status 201
< header ETag {etag:reminder-new.ics}

# A weekly one on a date and a sub-task of the first (RELATED-TO).
> PUT /caldav/alex/calendars/erinnerungen--titanos/7E2D4C6B-8A9F-4E1D-B3C5-D7E9F1A3B5C7.ics
> Auth: alex
> Content-Type: text/calendar; charset=utf-8
> If-None-Match: *
> Body: reminder-weekly.ics
< status 201

> PUT /caldav/alex/calendars/erinnerungen--titanos/1D3F5A7C-9E2B-4D6F-8A1C-3E5B7D9F2A4C.ics
> Auth: alex
> Content-Type: text/calendar; charset=utf-8
> If-None-Match: *
> Body: reminder-sub.ics
< status 201

# The list is real now, with an epoch of its own: the token of the
# virtual list is stale (403, the device syncs once in full – as for
# "privat").
> REPORT /caldav/alex/calendars/erinnerungen--titanos/
> Auth: alex
>
> <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
> <A:sync-collection xmlns:A="DAV:"><A:sync-token>{saved:virtual}</A:sync-token><A:sync-level>1</A:sync-level><A:prop><A:getetag/></A:prop></A:sync-collection>
< status 403
< error d:valid-sync-token

> REPORT /caldav/alex/calendars/erinnerungen--titanos/
> Auth: alex
>
> <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
> <A:sync-collection xmlns:A="DAV:"><A:sync-token/><A:sync-level>1</A:sync-level><A:prop><A:getetag/></A:prop></A:sync-collection>
< status 207
< responses 3
< save token sync-token

# Its ctag moved, and so did the home's. "privat"
# stays virtual (a list is no calendar).
> PROPFIND /caldav/alex/calendars/
> Auth: alex
> Depth: 1
>
> <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
> <A:propfind xmlns:A="DAV:" xmlns:C="http://calendarserver.org/ns/"><A:prop><C:getctag/><A:displayname/></A:prop></A:propfind>
< status 207
< responses 3
< value /caldav/alex/calendars/privat/ cs:getctag 0-0
< value-not /caldav/alex/calendars/erinnerungen--titanos/ cs:getctag 0-0
< value /caldav/alex/calendars/erinnerungen--titanos/ d:displayname Erinnerungen
< value-not /caldav/alex/calendars/ cs:getctag {saved:home}

# The bytes come back as they went (X-APPLE-SORT-ORDER, X-WR-ALARMUID).
> GET /caldav/alex/calendars/erinnerungen--titanos/9B1F0D3E-2A4C-4B6D-8E0F-1A2B3C4D5E6F.ics
> Auth: alex
< status 200
< header ETag {etag:reminder-new.ics}
< header-has Content-Type text/calendar
< body reminder-new.ics

# The open ones, as iOS asks for them: COMPLETED is not defined.
> REPORT /caldav/alex/calendars/erinnerungen--titanos/
> Auth: alex
> Depth: 1
>
> <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
> <B:calendar-query xmlns:A="DAV:" xmlns:B="urn:ietf:params:xml:ns:caldav"><A:prop><A:getetag/><A:getcontenttype/></A:prop><B:filter><B:comp-filter name="VCALENDAR"><B:comp-filter name="VTODO"><B:prop-filter name="COMPLETED"><B:is-not-defined/></B:prop-filter></B:comp-filter></B:comp-filter></B:filter></B:calendar-query>
< status 207
< responses 3

# Ticked off on the iPhone: STATUS, COMPLETED, PERCENT-COMPLETE.
> PUT /caldav/alex/calendars/erinnerungen--titanos/9B1F0D3E-2A4C-4B6D-8E0F-1A2B3C4D5E6F.ics
> Auth: alex
> Content-Type: text/calendar; charset=utf-8
> If-Match: {etag:reminder-new.ics}
> Body: reminder-done.ics
< status 204
< header ETag {etag:reminder-done.ics}

> REPORT /caldav/alex/calendars/erinnerungen--titanos/
> Auth: alex
> Depth: 1
>
> <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
> <B:calendar-query xmlns:A="DAV:" xmlns:B="urn:ietf:params:xml:ns:caldav"><A:prop><A:getetag/></A:prop><B:filter><B:comp-filter name="VCALENDAR"><B:comp-filter name="VTODO"><B:prop-filter name="COMPLETED"><B:is-not-defined/></B:prop-filter></B:comp-filter></B:comp-filter></B:filter></B:calendar-query>
< status 207
< responses 2
< response-lacks /caldav/alex/calendars/erinnerungen--titanos/9B1F0D3E-2A4C-4B6D-8E0F-1A2B3C4D5E6F.ics

# The done ones of the last weeks: COMPLETED in a time-range.

< status 207
< responses 1
< data /caldav/alex/calendars/erinnerungen--titanos/9B1F0D3E-2A4C-4B6D-8E0F-1A2B3C4D5E6F.ics reminder-done.ics
